title: Equivariant Steklov homogenisation and stability of spectral representations
summary: We prove that isolated spectral clusters preserve their finite-group representation under equivariant spectral convergence. In particular, an irreducible limiting eigenspace cannot split into several nearby eigenvalues, while an isotypic limiting eigenspace imposes corresponding divisibility constraints on the multiplicities in the approximating cluster. We then construct a one-parameter equivariant Steklov homogenisation on closed orientable surfaces, allowing Laplace spectral representations to be transferred to Steklov spectral clusters.
